acquisition.method: exact HTTPS byte ranges from a pinned ZIP central-directory manifest; each selected XML member is streamed, verified, aggregated and released before the next member
acquisition.retry_scope: only the same exact member after a retryable transport failure; resource, pin, schema and content errors are terminal

excluded_source_values: all fields outside the strict address projection

transformations.shared_aggregation: Outcome-blind Germany-only strict normalized source projection into bounded SQLite. Source semantic multiplicity, coordinate/postcode conflicts, incomplete house identities and ambiguous locality relations fail closed.
transformations.source_only: Append only a unique strict address identity absent from the accepted base after exact product-visible locality/postcode arbitration. Source coordinates are payload only after admission and are never selectors against benchmark truth or results.
transformations.postcode_fill_only: Fill only blank postcode metadata on exact existing base street+locality-code+house+suffix identities. Preserve every base row, order and coordinate; add no source row and never write source coordinates.

warning: MaStR unit coordinates may describe an installation rather than a building centroid. The strict source-only candidate is evaluated separately with a paired harm budget; the postcode-fill candidate never consumes source coordinates.
